data.title: My data
data.exportHelp: All your measurements in a CSV file, readable by a spreadsheet.
data.deleteHelp: Permanently deletes your account and all your data (measurements, campaigns, settings), then signs you out. Consider exporting your data first.
data.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete your account and all your data? This cannot be undone.

form.title: Enter a slot
form.hint: Up to 3 measurements. An empty row is ignored.
form.free: Outside a campaign, measurements are saved as free measurements.
form.saved: {count, plural, one {# measurement saved} other {# measurements saved}}.

measurements.alert: Alert value: 180/110 or higher. Measure again at rest; if it is confirmed, seek medical advice. You can still save it.

errors.incomplete: Fill in systolic, diastolic and pulse, or leave the row empty.
errors.systolicNotAboveDiastolic: Systolic must be higher than diastolic.

offline.banner: No network. Saving is disabled, but what you type is kept.
offline.title: No network
offline.description: This page needs a connection. Anything you typed in a form is kept and will come back once you are online.

install.title: Install the app
install.intro: Installed on your home screen, the app opens like an app and can send you measurement reminders.
install.installed: The app is already installed on this device.

ios.share: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up).
ios.notifications: On iPhone and iPad, reminders only work once the app is installed (iOS 16.4 or later).

android.menu: In Chrome, open the menu (the three dots at the top right).
android.add: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

desktop.addressBar: In Chrome or Edge, click the install icon on the right of the address bar.
desktop.menu: Otherwise, open the browser menu and choose “Install Blood pressure”.
